name: Sign in and create event
description: Create an event and verify it persists.
steps: Verify the event-photo background, enlarged transparent logo and sign-in button are clearly visible.
Sign in
Create an event named Royal Gala with venue Kampala
Refresh the page
Open Events
Verify the sidebar shows a larger logo above the company name.
expected: Royal Gala is listed with Kampala. The logo has no black background and is clearly visible at a larger size.

name: Create seating and guests
description: Create a table and assign a guest.
setup: Sign in and create an event named Seating Test
steps: Select Seating Test
Add a VIP table named Table One with 8 seats
Add guest Alex and assign Table One
Open Guests
Open Tables and verify Table One appears in a readable card.
expected: Alex appears with Table One and VIP table capacity appears on the dashboard.

name: Validation and deletion
setup: Sign in and create an event named Delete Test
steps: Open Events
Try to add an event with an empty name
Cancel the form
Delete Delete Test and confirm
Refresh the page
expected: An empty event cannot be saved and Delete Test is absent.

name: Guest invitation and check-in
description: Generate an invitation, check a guest in and verify attendance remains recorded.
setup: Sign in and create an event named QR Test
Add a guest named Alex to QR Test
steps: Select QR Test
Open QR & Check-in
Generate QR for Alex
Download QR code
Search for Alex under Find a guest
Click Check in and confirm
Refresh the page
Search for Alex again
Open Overview and download attendance CSV
Paste invalid into Invitation code and click Validate code. Verify it is rejected without changing attendance.
expected: The QR is displayed and downloadable, Alex remains checked in, another check-in is disabled, and attendance shows one checked-in guest.

name: Manage event preparation sections
covers: service supplier and planned cost fields
services GET POST PUT DELETE endpoint family
service options backend validation and storage
description: Create and manage preparations across all four event sections and verify event separation.
setup: Sign in and create an event named Preparation Gala
Create a second event named Other Gala
steps: Select Preparation Gala

Open Food & Beverage. Add Buffet Lunch, supplier Royal Caterers, planned total cost 100000 UGX and status Booked. In its food menu select Buffet and Juice, add custom option Vegetarian meals, then save.
Open Costume and add Bridal Outfits with Traditional wear selected.
Open Decoration and add Floral Centerpieces with Floral arrangements selected.
Open Sound System and add Wireless Microphones with Wireless microphones selected.
Refresh and select Preparation Gala. Verify each item remains in its section
Expand each item’s menu and verify the selected options remain after refresh. Edit Buffet Lunch to remove Juice, save, refresh and verify Buffet and Vegetarian meals remain but Juice is absent.
Edit Buffet Lunch to Royal Buffet, cost 120000 and status Ready
Search for Royal Buffet and filter Ready. Verify its updated details
Select Other Gala and verify Royal Buffet is not listed
Select Preparation Gala. Delete Royal Buffet and confirm
Open Add item and try saving an empty item name
expected: All four sections store their own items, edits persist, the other event does not show them, confirmed deletion removes the item, and an empty name cannot be saved. Selected preset and custom menu options persist, can be removed through editing, and appear in each item’s expandable menu.
